mines.mine_notes: Open pit mining commenced in FY26 (contractor: Mineral Mining Services Pty Ltd). Waste stripping ramped up in H2 (375kBCM); first ore before year end: 8.3 kt @ 1.2 g/t for 328 oz.
Development approved during FY26; portal to be established. Estimated capital cost ~A$85 million. Maiden Ore Reserve 825 kt @ 3.8 g/t for 101 koz declared in FY26.
Pre-feasibility study complete; Final Investment Decision anticipated late FY27. Maiden Ore Reserve 3.669 Mt @ 1.9 g/t for 223 koz. Round Dam Mineral Resource grew tenfold to 1.33 Moz during FY26.

notes: FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026): record annual gold production of 140,949 oz (incl. 34,279 oz of attributable equivalent production from third-party milling), a 53% increase on FY25 (92,399 oz). Gold sold 140,641 oz (106,362 oz from Davyhurst plant + 34,279 oz equivalent from Paddington); average realised gold price A$5,742/oz; revenue A$807.5M; net profit after tax A$216.2M; EBITDA A$448.8M. Group AISC A$3,496/oz sold (4% above revised guidance $3,250-$3,350/oz; costs disclosed in AUD only, no per-mine cost breakdown). Davyhurst plant milled 1,258,483t at 2.9 g/t head grade with 92% recovery for 106,670 oz produced; third-party milling hauled 625,251t @ 2.0 g/t for 34,279 oz equivalent. Closing cash A$267.7M; net cash flow generated A$183.5M after ~A$236M invested in capital projects, mine development and exploration; upsized A$200M undrawn RCF. Group MRE 56.5 Mt @ 2.0 g/t = 3.69 Moz (+75%) and Ore Reserve 8.4 Mt @ 2.3 g/t = 610 koz (+159%), both as at 1 April 2026. New 3 Mtpa mill construction approved to proceed. FY27 guidance: 125-140 koz Au @ AISC A$3,400-$3,600/oz. All dollar figures in AUD unless stated.
